# AgenteDirect

AgenteDirect is a web design agency based in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. We build custom, professional websites for local businesses — contractors, auto body shops, entertainment companies, paving companies, restaurants, and service providers across Montreal and Quebec.

## What We Do
- Custom website design and development
- Bilingual websites (English and French / bilingues EN/FR)
- Mobile-first, responsive design
- SEO-optimized builds
- Ongoing hosting and support

## Pricing
No published prices. Every project is quoted to fit the business. Request a free quote at https://agentedirect.ca/inquiry. No long-term contracts.

## Who We Serve
Local businesses in Montreal, Laval, Longueuil, Quebec City, and across Canada. Industries include home services, contracting, automotive, restaurants, entertainment, professional services, and retail.

## Real Client Work
- CarWorks Canada — Auto body & collision repair, Saint-Laurent, Montreal (carworkscanada.com)
- Jakoa Productions — DJ & event entertainment, Montreal (jakoa.ca)

## Demo Sites (concept work, not real clients)
- Pavage Gagnon & Fils — Paving & exterior works (gagnonfils.netlify.app)
- La Cucina — Italian restaurant (lacucina.agentedirect.ca)
- Ciel Residences — Luxury real estate (cielresidence.netlify.app)
